contexts.text: That all things they know and think... are walls of loose stones. Signified, Explained.
A house full of holes and surrounded by a rough wall, seen.
Wander among the walls () = among truths destroyed through falsities. ( = thought and life from falsities. AE 435:7.) AE 637:10.
The slight wall which they daub with what is untempered () = falsity adopted as a principle, and made to appear as truth...
I will encompass wall with wall () = to heap falsities upon falsities.

Which sit in the walls in the day of cold () = in truths of the Word which do not appear as truths because they are falsified, and because they are from evil; walls = truths which do not appear because they are falsified.
To take away the hedge, and break down the wall () = to falsify, and thus destroy, the truths which defend the Church. Explained.
